title: Clowns
build: 8 KB Ultimax cartridge (CRT name "Clowns", hardware type 0, EXROM 1, GAME 0, ROM at $E000-$FFFF); ROM SHA-1 ffebfc19263dc50d3a808135dbe88567617af6b8

tools.emulator: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134 (VICE x64sc, PAL)
tools.host: Windows 11 Pro with WSL2, Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS

exclude: runtime: the only RAM the Ultimax configuration shows. Zero page, stack, $0200-$03FF and the screen hold variables, the software stack, sprite 0's shape and the screen, all built by the cartridge's code; nothing of the game is loaded there
not mapped: in the Ultimax configuration $1000-$CFFF is open bus for the processor, and $D000-$DFFF is I/O; nothing of the game is there
